choices.name: Teragard's Aegis
effects: Base ability damage gains 25% of total armour value, doubled with a defender and tripled with a shield.
Base health regeneration gains 2.5% of maximum life points with the same multipliers.

assumptions: Uses resolved total Armour; the Armour contribution is added before ability bands.

choices.name: Big Boned
effects: Maximum life points +50%.
Damage dealt gains bonus damage equal to 5% of maximum life points.

assumptions: The bonus damage is an attached, non-critical component on the first qualifying hit and has its own hit cap.

choices.name: Adrenaline Junkie
effects: Maximum adrenaline +50%.
Adrenaline generation +50%.

assumptions: The generation multiplier applies to listed ability adrenaline gains, not refunds or unrelated grants.

reason: Give the revealed tier-one blessings stable combat IDs and data-driven provisional mechanics. These source records rebuild through SQLite into the bounded blessing document.

choices.name: Striking Light
effects: Basic attack damage +40%.
Basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin on a 9-second cooldown for 40-60% ability damage plus 250% of armour value.

assumptions: Basic attack includes auto-attacks and Basic-category abilities; Light is a separate critical-eligible hit with its own cap.

choices.name: Barkscales
effects: Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of armour value.
After five reductions, triggers Grasp of Guthix for 80-120% ability damage as poison in a 3x3 area.

choices.name: Abyssal Cinders
effects: Attacks deal 15% of ability damage as bonus damage.
5% on-hit chance to trigger Inferno of Zamorak for 100-200% ability damage to one target.

assumptions: The 15% component is attached and non-critical on every qualifying hit; Inferno is a non-recursive critical-eligible expected-value event rolled once per cast.

reason: Give the revealed tier-two blessings stable combat IDs, support status, and data-driven outgoing mechanics while leaving incoming-combat Barkscales excluded.

choices.name: Steadfast Will
effects: Empowers Bash, Preparation, Reflect, and Revenge.

choices.name: Eternal Sustenance
effects: Food is not consumed when eaten.
Eating no longer drains adrenaline.

choices.name: Avernic Rampage
effects: 5% on-attack chance to activate a 7.2-second window where abilities and special attacks cost 0% adrenaline.

assumptions: The triggering attack pays its normal cost; a proc opens or refreshes a 12-tick half-open free-cast window.

reason: Give the revealed tier-three blessings stable combat IDs and route only the supported outgoing and stateful pieces.

choices.name: Sacred Fervor
effects: Ability and special-attack cooldowns are reduced by 30% for all four combat styles.

excluded: Dynamic cooldowns not represented by an ability record
assumptions: Cooldown creation uses floor(default ticks x 0.7); cast occupancy and the global cooldown do not change.

choices.name: Splash Zone
effects: AoE and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
AoE abilities deal 5% more damage per tile occupied by the target.

assumptions: Only explicitly tagged attacks qualify; AoE adds 5% per declared occupied target tile with no guessed cap.

choices.name: Demon's Mark
effects: Accuracy is always calculated using the target's weakness.

assumptions: An explicitly declared applicable weakness selects the most favorable affinity; a manual Damage Potential override remains authoritative.

reason: Give the revealed God Tier One blessings stable combat IDs and data-driven provisional mechanics.
